newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks slip on profit-taking in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks slip on profit-taking in dull trade.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed lower on Monday as broad profit-taking took effect after the Ibex failed to overcome a key resistance zone, dealers said.
The Ibex fell 58.08 points, 0.87 percent, to 6,627.20 and the general index shed 3.91 points, 0.67 percent, to 578.38.
There was little company news, and much of business was related to futures trades with a large number of put-throughs.

An agreement among European finance ministers on a stability pact had little impact, as it been discounted to some extent, and many were awaiting political backing from the summit. Some dealers said it did little to dispel worries as to how monetary union will proceed in the future.
"There are questions hanging over EMU, and we could still be in for a bumpy ride for the rest of the year," said a dealer at an independent brokerage.
There was some selective buying, but many key stocks slipped sharply on what dealers said were technical factors.
Iberdrola fell 40 pesetas to 1,770 while Endesa was also off 110 pesetas to 11,130. Telefonica also shifted down 35 pesetas to 4,330.
